news_items.headline: Dodgers commit to Skubal for Game 1 start in NLDS, source says
news_items.description: Dodgers ace Tarik Skubal will get the ball in Game 1 of the National League Division Series against the Atlanta Braves on Saturday, a source told ESPN on Friday.

news_items.headline: Red Sox's Mickey Gasper has surgery to repair right biceps tendon
news_items.description: Red Sox first baseman/catcher Mickey Gasper has undergone a repair of his right biceps tendon after he left the team's regular-season finale and did not appear in the playoffs.

news_items.headline: White Sox to start reliever Hagen Smith vs. Guardians in ALDS
news_items.description: Reliever Hagen Smith will start for the White Sox against the Guardians in what will be a battle of rookie left-handed pitchers in Game 1 of the ALDS.
